label: Adform FLOW
terms_note: API use requires an Adform DSP user account plus an OAuth client with scopes assigned by Adform Support; "please contact us to enable access for you".

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Adform API client credentials / authorization code; enabled by Adform on request)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Adform API: campaigns, line items, orders, creatives, tags, reporting, DMP) Confidence: **high** — official (legacy) API portal read; current docs live on Adform Help.
auth: 1. Adform client → ask Adform to enable API access and create an API client (Authorization guide).
2. OAuth 2.0 (client credentials or authorization code) → bearer token.
3. Follow Campaigns Setup / Creatives Setup / Reporting guides.
reference.limits: - System Limits guide (values not read); contract-based access; Adform fees.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id of an Adform API client enabled for the client-credentials flow (requested from Adform support; https://api.adform.com/help/guides/getting-started/authorization-guide).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The client's secret, sent in the form body of POST https://id.adform.com/sts/connect/token; the client must be granted the buyer.advertisers.readonly and buyer.campaigns.api.readonly scopes. Tokens last about an hour and are re-requested automatically.

me.note: GET /v1/buyer/advertisers?limit=1: confirms the client credentials and scopes (Adform has no who-am-i endpoint).

list_accounts.note: GET /v1/buyer/advertisers (offset/limit): the advertisers the client can access, active and inactive ({id, name, timeZone, status}); no currency on this record.

list_campaigns.note: GET /v1/buyer/campaigns?advertisers={account_id} (offset/limit). `status` is Active or Inactive; without it Adform returns only active campaigns. `budget` is the campaign's planning budget (total, not daily) in `currency`.

not_offered.get_report: Adform's Buyer Stats API is asynchronous: "POST /v1/buyer/stats/data — Order asynchronous report generation", then poll GET /v1/buyer/stats/operations/{id} and fetch GET /v1/buyer/stats/data/{id} (https://api.adform.com/v1/help/buyer/stats); the runtime has no report polling.
not_offered.update_budget: Adform campaigns carry only a total planning `budget`, changed through the full-object "PUT /v1/buyer/campaigns/{id} — Updates a single campaign general details" (advertiserId, name, currency, dates, subType… required); there is no daily campaign budget.
not_offered.pause_resume: "PUT /v1/buyer/campaigns/{id}/status — Activates or deactivates campaign" takes a bare JSON string body ("Active" / "Inactive"), which the adapter body builder cannot send (it builds JSON objects/arrays).

evidence: host api.adform.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
